The PKGBUILD has no global scope execution and the package() function only installs files. The disagreement is purely due to a transient API error in one model.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' because it failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly returned 'safe'.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: When a model fails to audit a purely declarative metadata file like .SRCINFO due to a transient API error, the overall verdict should not be forced to 'inconclusive' if the critical executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and found safe.
